CalloutConfig.DispatchText: Small fire - someone got a burn and needs help.
CalloutConfig.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A small fire nearby, someone has a burn. Please respond.
CalloutConfig.EnRouteHelpText: Drive to the yellow marker, then get out and walk up to the patient.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneText: You're on scene. Check on the patient.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneVoiceLine: On scene. Checking on the patient now.

OnSceneTextVariants.string: There they are. Let's see about that burn.
You made it. Time to check on them.
On scene - let's take a look at that kitchen mishap.

CalloutConfig.AssessmentHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to help the patient.
CalloutConfig.ConversationHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to talk to the patient.
CalloutConfig.TreatingText: Cooling the burn and covering it...

TreatingTextVariants.string: Running cool water over the burn...
Gently cooling it down and wrapping it...
Cooling the burn and keeping it covered...

PatientThanksTextVariants.string: Thanks, that feels so much better!
Ouch, but thank you for the help!

CalloutConfig.ResolutionVoiceLine: Nice work. The patient is going to be just fine.

Injury.DispatchText: Small fire - someone has a little burn on their hand.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A small fire nearby, someone has a minor burn. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Patient
DialogueLine.Text: I touched the flames and burnt my hand a little.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Let's cool that under water and pop a light dressing on.

Injury.TreatedText: All better! The burn is cooled and covered - good as new.

Injury.DispatchText: Small fire - someone has a sore burn that needs dressing.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A small fire nearby, someone has a sore burn. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Patient
DialogueLine.Text: The burn really stings, it's gone a bit blistery.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: I'll cool it properly and wrap it up nice and clean.

Injury.TreatedText: Nice work - burn cooled and dressed, the patient feels much better.

Injury.DispatchText: Fire - someone has a bad burn and needs the hospital.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A fire nearby, someone has a bad burn. Please respond quickly.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Patient
DialogueLine.Text: It's a really bad burn... it hurts so much.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: I'm cooling it and covering it - the ambulance will take you to hospital.

Injury.TransportedText: Great job! The patient is taken to the hospital to care for the burn.
